bays.restriction: Resident permit zone N (New Eltham), London Borough of Bexley. During the controlled hours, marked bays are for permit holders; visitors visiting a resident use visitor scratch cards (booklet of 10 for £22; one card validates one day). Zone centre point — the zone's streets are signed at its boundary.
bays.tariff: No hourly visitor tariff — permit holders and visitor scratch cards only
bays.pay: Visitor scratch cards (from residents); permits online from the council
bays.permits: Resident permit £41 for 3 months / £135 for 1 year; visitor scratch cards £22 per booklet of 10 (council permit charges tables)

bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — Mottingham (Zone M), Royal Borough of Greenwich. Permit holders park in marked bays; visitors pay by phone or pay-and-display where bays are shared-use, or use visitor vouchers. Zone centre point — the zone's streets are signed at its boundary.
bays.times: Monday to Friday: 1:30pm to 3pm. Permits not needed: Christmas Day (25 December), Boxing Day (26 December), 1 January, Good Friday and Easter Monday, May Day (Early May), Spring Bank Holiday (late May) and Summer Bank Holiday (late August).
bays.tariff: Hourly rates by location band (council prices page): Band A £3.10, Band B £6.20, Band C £8.30 per hour at the machine (cash pay-and-display pays the base rate). PayByPhone applies a CO2 discount automatically — 1 hour by CO2 (g/km), Band A/B/C: 0: £1.10/£2.20/£2.90; 1-50: £1.20/£2.50/£3.30; 51-75: £1.40/£2.80/£3.70; 76-90: £1.60/£3.10/£4.20; 91-100: £1.70/£3.40/£4.60; 101-110: £1.90/£3.70/£5.00; 111-130: £2.00/£2.00/£2.00 (as published); 131-150: £2.20/£4.40/£5.80; 151-170: £2.30/£4.70/£6.20; 171-190: £2.50/£5.00/£6.60; 191-225: £2.60/£5.30/£7.10; 226-255: £2.80/£5.60/£7.50; over 255: £3.10/£6.20/£8.30. Which band a street is in is shown on its machine and in the PayByPhone app — the council does not publish a per-zone band
bays.pay: PayByPhone (app — CO2 discount applied automatically) or pay-and-display machine
bays.permits: Resident permit (12 months): Base price £106. Discounts and additional charges apply based on your vehicle’s carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions and fuel type.. Visitor vouchers: £13.50 per 10 vouchers. Business permit (12 months): Base price £368. Discounts and additional charges apply based on your vehicle’s carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions.. Multi-vehicle business permit: £960. Business visitor vouchers: N/A. Nanny permit: £132 (permits are also available at a pro rata charge for 3 or 6 month periods). Doctor permit: £343 (permits are also available at a pro rata charge for 3 or 6 month periods). Tradesperson permit: £31.10 per week. Car club permit: £291. Carer permit: £15.60. You can buy up to 200 visitor vouchers in 12 months, starting from the date you buy the first ones.
